name: Citizenship by Registration -- Marriage to a Nigerian Citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be a woman who is or has been married to a citizen of Nigeria (Section 26(1)(a)) -- there is no equivalent registration route for a man married to a Nigerian woman.

evidence_required.document: Letter of consent from husband (or from children/relatives if husband is deceased)
Passport photograph, birth certificate, residence permit

sources.title: Citizenship and Business Department, Federal Ministry of Interior, Nigeria -- Citizenship Requirements: 'Citizenship by Registration (Section 26(2A))' document checklist requires a 'Letter Of Consent from Husband/Children/Relatives In Case Of Deceased Husband' and documentation of the husband's citizenship status, confirming this registration route applies to women married to Nigerian men

Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, 1999 (as amended), Chapter III -- Section 26: registration eligibility includes 'women married to Nigerian citizens (current or former)', subject to Presidential satisfaction of good character, domicile intent, and oath compliance

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Nigeria). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- primary structural requirement tier-1 sourced directly from the Ministry of Interior's own citizenship-requirements document, which itself confirms the gendered structure through its required-document list. MARQUEE GENDERED FINDING, MORE SEVERE THAN THE PATRILINEAL-DESCENT PATTERNS SEEN ELSEWHERE IN THIS DATASET (Qatar, Bahrain): Nigeria's Constitution (Section 26(1)(a)) grants a citizenship-by-registration route ONLY to a woman who is or has been married to a Nigerian citizen -- there is NO equivalent constitutional registration route for a man married to a Nigerian woman. This is distinct from ng_family_reunification.json's N1A residence visa, which IS gender-neutral -- meaning a foreign husband of a Nigerian wife can live in Nigeria on a spousal residence visa but has no marriage-based path to Nigerian citizenship itself, only the general naturalisation route (ng_citizenship_naturalisation.json) open to anyone regardless of marital status. No explicit residence-duration requirement was found for this registration route beyond the marriage itself and Presidential satisfaction of the other Section 26 criteria -- citizenship_after_months is therefore set to 0 rather than an invented waiting period. DISCLOSED BUT NOT MODELED AS A HARD REQUIREMENT: Section 26 also requires the President's satisfaction of good character, domicile intent, and oath compliance (tier-2 sourced, citizenshiprightsafrica.org) -- omitted from requirement_groups here to keep this file's hard requirements cleanly tier-1, since only the marriage-to-citizen condition itself is independently tier-1 confirmed via the Ministry's own document checklist. dual_citizenship_allowed is FALSE per the same Section 28 forfeiture rule described in ng_citizenship_naturalisation.json, since registration (like naturalisation) is not citizenship by birth.
